closure_rule: Replay every historical case for which both real production source identity and exact source bytes are still preserved. Never promote visible-only or same-byte proposition proxies into raw-source replay evidence.

full_raw_body_replay.reason: Historical production artifacts intentionally omitted article bodies and fact objects.

historical_visible_proxy_corpus.allowed_use: visible-label regression inventory and historical acceptance evidence only
historical_visible_proxy_corpus.forbidden_use: must not be reported as raw article replay or source-to-publication production replay

unbound_exact_source_regressions.description: Many historical live regression tests preserve exact source clauses but do not independently preserve enough production artifact URL/body provenance to qualify as source replay inputs without reconstruction or guessing.
unbound_exact_source_regressions.policy: keep as unit/regression evidence; exclude from Phase 5 real-source replay count

phase5_claim: The recoverable historical source evidence has been replayed through the actual production entrypoint. Historical full-body replay remains impossible for evidence that was deliberately not persisted; this limitation is permanent for those runs and is not a test failure.
next_phase_gate: Measure correctness and recall only against evidence classes whose expected outcome and provenance are explicit; report unsupported historical coverage separately instead of fabricating denominators.
